title: Side Step Plant And Cut Sharp (Chas McIvor)
style: country swing bluegrass banjo brass bongo fast beat 134bpm comedy dad voice spoken interjections southern drawl harmonica fiddle
lyrics:
[Intro - Chas spoken]
I say son, the side step beats the tackler
Plant the foot hard, cut sharp the other way
Go right to go left, son, the magic move

[Verse 1]
Approach the defender at full pace, head straight
Plant the lead foot wide outside the body weight
Bend the knee deep, push off explosive
Cut sharp ninety degrees the other way commosive

[Pre-Chorus]
The defender commits to the plant foot direction
When you cut back, the angle is correction
Acceleration through the gap at full speed
Leave the tackler in the dust, indeed

[Chorus]
Side step plant and cut sharp, son
Go right to go left, the work begun
Plant the foot wide, push off the ground
Cut ninety degrees, change of bound

[Verse 2]
Timing is everything, son, plant at three metres
Not too early, not too late, perfect meters
The defender must be committed to your fake
Then the cut works, the gap you take

[Bridge - Chas spoken]
I say boy, the side step is a one off
Dont overuse it, dont get scoff
Once a game, twice maybe, well timed
The element of surprise, son, primed

[Chorus]
Side step plant and cut sharp, son
Go right to go left, the work begun
Plant the foot wide, push off the ground
Cut ninety degrees, change of bound

[Outro]
Plant wide, push off explosive
Cut sharp, ninety responsive
Go right to go left, magic
Thats my boy, that is fantastic
